thread:
Ellen: Tiny kitchen FYI  tea drawer is a mess  a bunch of loose teabags and open boxes dumped in, crumbs everywhere. can the last brewer please tidy? :tea:
Raj: guilty, sorry! grabbed a tin too fast and knocked stuff over. I wiped the counter but missed crumbs under the kettle.
Kai: Proposal: magnetic tins for opened boxes (so theyre sealed) + little labels for Opened: MM/DD and Owner (optional). Keeps teas fresh.
Monica: Also the sugar packet jar is full of used wrappers. Can we swap to a small lidded canister so sugar stays dry and no ants?
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Tea stash check" Thursdays @ 4pm. React :thumbsup: to join.
Ellen: Bonus ask: if you bring strong condiments (chili oil, fish sauce) put a name/date on them so people know how long they've been there. Smelly surprises are a morale hazard. :laughing:
Raj: I can bring a set of magnetic tins + sticky labels tomorrow. Will also put a short note in the kitchen with reorg time.
Kai: Quick poll: do a 15-min tea-drawer reorg Thursday 4:15pm? :one: yes :two: no
Monica: :one:
Ellen: :one:
Raj: :one:
kitchen-bot: "Tea stash check" event updated to include reorg time. Thanks everyone!
